pack.name: Sales Diagnostic
pack.description: Production methodology for sales strategy, demand generation, qualification, response, pipeline, conversion, productivity, CRM quality, forecasting and enablement.

cost_per_lead.description: Acquisition spend divided by verified leads created in the same attribution window.

pipeline_coverage.description: Qualified open pipeline value divided by remaining period sales target.

pipeline_velocity.description: Opportunity count multiplied by average deal value and win rate, divided by sales cycle days.

opportunity_age.description: Median elapsed days from opportunity creation to the evaluation date.

stage_conversion_rate.description: Opportunities entering the next stage divided by opportunities eligible to advance.

stage_duration.description: Median elapsed days between verified stage entry and exit timestamps.

sales_cycle_length.description: Median days from qualified opportunity creation to closed outcome.

activity_per_rep.description: Verified selling activities divided by active sales representatives for the period.

revenue_per_rep.description: Recognized sales revenue divided by active sales representatives for the period.

coaching_frequency.description: Documented coaching sessions divided by active representatives per month.
